coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 16B (UCSF planned)
record.summary: Block 16B is at UCSF's Mission Bay North Campus. UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists Blocks 16A and B as undeveloped research parcels with 'no building plans at Mission Bay right now'; UCSF's May 2026 approval of a five-level ear and hearing building covers Block 16A and 'a portion of Block 16B'. A UCSF Preliminary Utilities Plant already stands on Block 16B (per UCSF's 2017 environmental addendum), so the block is not wholly undeveloped.

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary: the city block outlined by DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

record.notes: UCSF's June 12, 2025 Mission Bay CAC presentation lists Block 16A & B among UCSF Mission Bay's 'Undeveloped parcels remaining' (planned use per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan: Research) and says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map designates this block for future UCSF institutional use, but no specific project, developer or timeline was found. Whether the block is currently used as surface parking is not confirmed: an earlier note said so (satellite- and building-footprint-confirmed as of 2026-09-19), but no imagery or other source is cited for it, and the plan map shows planned uses, not current conditions.
